index.title: Outreach
index.description: Agents people can reach from a chat app, each through its own linked account.
index.emptyBody: An agent appears here once it has a linked account. Add an agent to give it a Feishu account.

add.title: Add an agent
add.description: Pick the agent people should reach. Next, you give it a Feishu account.
add.footnote_one: {{count}} agent has no linked account. Agents are created and edited in Apps.
add.footnote_other: {{count}} agents have no linked account. Agents are created and edited in Apps.

newBot.title: Give {{agent}} a Feishu account
newBot.description: The account is linked to {{agent}}. You can link it to another agent later.
newBot.name: Account name in Feishu
newBot.nameHint: People see this name in groups and @mention it.
newBot.qrAlt: QR code for the Feishu app
newBot.scanBody: Feishu creates the {{bot}} account in your workspace and links it to Rome.

overview.botsBody: {{agent}} speaks through these accounts. Each one also shows in Connections.
overview.noBots: {{agent}} has no linked account yet. Give it a Feishu account, then invite it to any group or DM.
overview.inviteBody: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Feishu. Chats appear here on their own.

chat.shared_one: {{bots}} is in this chat too. Rome keeps one history for it, so every agent here reads the same messages.
chat.shared_other: {{bots}} are in this chat too. Rome keeps one history for it, so every agent here reads the same messages.
chat.settings: Chat settings: answers when @mentioned · replies in thread

activity.description: What was said to and by {{agent}} across its chats, newest first.

settings.readOthersBody: When off, {{agent}} only sees the chat it is answering in.
settings.introduce: Introduce itself when added to a group
settings.introduceBody: Posts one short hello with what it can help with.
settings.botsBody: Linked agent sets which agent speaks through an account. Chats cannot change it.
settings.moveConfirm_one: Link {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chat. The chat and its history stay as they are.
settings.moveConfirm_other: Link {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chats. The chats and their history stay as they are.
settings.foldersBody: Limits which files the agent can read or write. Shell access is off for agents with folders.
settings.noFolders: No folders. This agent sees the whole workspace.
